formation: Simplified form of 訊. Depicts a mouth (口) interrogating a captured prisoner of war (卂). 卂 also represents the sound. The 口 (mouth) component was later reanalyzed as 讠 (speech).

components.note: 讠 is a component form of 言. Originally 口 (mouth). Later reanalyzed as 讠 (speech).
Depicts a captive prisoner with their hands tied behind their back.
